documentedBehavior: A false exact-branch entry prevents a deployment upon commits; unspecified branches default to true.
configurationReview: Exactly one branch entry; no true/wildcard override; no root vercel.ts or vercel.toml; no application build/runtime keys added.

knownWorkflowReview.trigger: push to condition/spec-driven only when this workflow path changes

verificationLimit: Pre-push documentary/configuration verification; post-push provider/check status is a separate observation, not an intentional deployment test.
